review_evidence: README describes a Lean language and library guide built around extensive executable code examples, with the source authored in Lean and mechanically checked during the build.
The hydrated source contains 409 Lean files and 921 proposition declarations.
Pedagogical examples and checked theorem snippets remain valid formal prior-art/search content under the repository-review policy.
summary: Retain Lean by Example as a large, build-checked pedagogical corpus of Lean definitions, examples, and proofs.
